title: GPM IMERG Final Run daily precipitation (GPM_3IMERGDF v07)
message: GES DISC refused the download: HTTP 403 (EULA Acceptance Failure)
action_needed: Sign in at https://urs.earthdata.nasa.gov with the account that issued EARTHDATA_TOKEN, then open https://urs.earthdata.nasa.gov/approve_app?client_id=e2WVk8Pw6weeLUKZYOxvTQ and approve 'NASA GESDISC DATA ARCHIVE' (Applications > Authorized Apps > Approve More Applications). No new token is needed. Then run `python -m pipeline.s02_imerg` and `python -m pipeline.s20_indicators`.
